content: Create a document or upload your own files. Everything you add will appear in {{sectionName}}, ready to organize, edit, and share.

comment.text: Body of the closing Files onboarding tour step: highlights the empty screen's create options (after the sample files are removed) or the New button. {{sectionName}} is the translated name of the Files section.
